Self.Wiki: This map object represents a part within the map.

ModelName.Wiki: The model of the map object, corresponding to an entry in the ModelParam.

InstanceID.Wiki: Determines the instance of this map object. Should be unique between map objects of the same model name.

SibPath.Wiki: A path to a .sib file, presumed to be some kind of editor placeholder.

Rotation.Wiki: Rotation of the map object, in degrees.

Scale.Wiki: Scale of the map object, only meaningful for map pieces and objects.

GameEditionDisable.Wiki: Determines the loading of this map object.

MapStudioLayer.Wiki: The map layer this map object is placed on.

EntityID.Wiki: Identifies the map object in event scripts.

isUsePartsDrawParamID.Wiki: If ON, enables use of PartsDrawParamID. If false, asset param is used instead.

PartsDrawParamID.Wiki: The PartsDrawParam row used when Use Parts Draw Param ID is on; -1 for none. Each draw flag below falls back to this row when its override is off.

OverridePointLightShadowSrc.Wiki: If ON, Is Point Light Shadow Source is used instead of the draw param's isPointLightShadowSrc.

IsPointLightShadowSrc.Wiki: Whether the map object casts point light shadows. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideDirLightShadowSrc.Wiki: If ON, Is Sun Shadow Source is used instead of the draw param's isDirLightShadowSrc (on by default).

IsDirLightShadowSrc.Wiki: Whether the map object casts the sun's (directional light's) shadow. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideShadowDest.Wiki: If ON, Is Shadow Destination is used instead of the draw param's isShadowDst (on by default).

IsShadowDest.Wiki: Whether shadows fall on the map object. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideShadowOnly.Wiki: If ON, Is Shadow Only is used instead of the draw param's isShadowOnly.

IsShadowOnly.Wiki: Whether the map object is only drawn into shadows. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideDrawByReflectCam.Wiki: If ON, Is Drawn by Reflection Camera is used instead of the draw param's drawByReflectCam.

DrawByReflectCam.Wiki: Whether the map object is drawn by the reflection camera. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideDrawOnlyReflectCam.AltName: Override: Only Drawn by Reflection Camera
OverrideDrawOnlyReflectCam.Wiki: If ON, Is Only Drawn by Reflection Camera is used instead of the draw param's drawOnlyReflectCam.

DrawOnlyReflectCam.AltName: Is Only Drawn by Reflection Camera
DrawOnlyReflectCam.Wiki: Whether the map object is only drawn by the reflection camera. Only used when its override is ON.

EntityGroupIDs.Wiki: A entity group ID this map object belongs to

UnkE3C.Wiki: An ID, -1 when unused. Set on few map objects (values such as 400-437, 800-837, 900-999).

UnkE3E.Wiki: Becomes one of the map object's render flags. Mostly set on objects in the distant-view (LOD) maps.

DisplayDataStruct.Wiki: Display and draw groups, with an alternate set of each that the game can swap or merge in on load.

DisplayGroups.Wiki: The groups this map object shows; for a collision, the groups shown while the player stands on it.

AltDisplayGroups.Wiki: Display groups that replace, or are merged into, the display groups when Use Alternate Groups is ON.

AltDisplayGroupsMask.Wiki: When merging, the display group bits set here are kept; the rest come from the alternate display groups.

DrawGroups.Wiki: Controls when the map object is visible: it is drawn while any of these groups is shown. A collision is always also in its own display groups.

AltDrawGroups.Wiki: Draw groups merged into the draw groups when Use Alternate Groups is ON.

AltDrawGroupsMask.Wiki: When merging, the draw group bits set here are kept; the rest come from the alternate draw groups.

NoAltGroupMerge.Wiki: If ON, the alternate groups are never merged in, only swapped in whole.

UseAltGroups.Wiki: Enables the alternate groups. Depending on a game state, the display groups are replaced by the alternate display groups, or both sets are merged in through their masks.

DispGroups.Wiki: Controls when the map object is visible.

LightSetID.Wiki: The ID of the value set from LightSet ParamEditor to use.

FogParamID.Wiki: The ID of the value set from FogParamEditor to use.

LightScatteringID.Wiki: The ID of the value set from LightScattering : ParamEditor to use.

EnvMapID.Wiki: The ID of the value set from Env Map:Editor to use.

TransitionTime.Wiki: Amount of time it takes for GParam to transition (in seconds). -1 = Some default time.

GparamSubID_Base.Wiki: Value of the hundredths place of a Gparam to override use.

GparamSubID_Override1.Wiki: Value of the hundredths place of a Gparam to override Base with.

GparamSubID_Override2.Wiki: Value of the hundredths place of a Gparam to override Base and Override 1 with.

GparamSubID_Override3.Wiki: Value of the hundredths place of a Gparam to override Base and Override 1 and Override 2 with.

GrassParamId0.Wiki: The ID in GrassTypeParam determining properties of dynamic grass on a map piece.

GrassParamId1.Wiki: The ID in GrassTypeParam determining properties of dynamic grass on a map piece.

GrassParamId2.Wiki: The ID in GrassTypeParam determining properties of dynamic grass on a map piece.

GrassParamId3.Wiki: The ID in GrassTypeParam determining properties of dynamic grass on a map piece.

GrassParamId4.Wiki: The ID in GrassTypeParam determining properties of dynamic grass on a map piece.

GrassParamId5.Wiki: The ID in GrassTypeParam determining properties of dynamic grass on a map piece.

GrassConfigStruct_Unk18.Wiki: Returned by a virtual of the grass map part. -1 in retail.

GrassConfigStruct_Unk1a.Wiki: Returned by a virtual of the grass map part. -1 in retail.

UnkStruct9_Unk00.Wiki: Render flag: 1 or 2 sets one bit of the part's render flags, 2 also a second; copied into the model instance and the renderer.

NamePrefixLength.Wiki: Characters at the start of the part name the game skips to get its plain name: 13 for names starting mAA_BB_CC_DD-, else 0.

TileLoadConfig_Unk0C.Wiki: Index into the collision instances of the map in Map ID; -1 for none.

CullingHeightBehavior.Wiki: Unknown culling behaviour field for extreme height differences. Values 0000 - 10000.
